worldcombat.skill.stoneaxe.summary: An overhead stone axe leaves a limited number of stone shards floating around the landing point: every enemy that newly enters that air is struck by one falling rock, airborne or not, and the field is spent once the rocks run out; a roof blocks the fall. The axe aims at a weak point and lands criticals more often than ordinary moves; a Shatter field drops the whole stock on its first intruder for one heavy blow.
worldcombat.skill.stoneaxe.use.0: A close axe swing that leaves floating rocks around the foe
worldcombat.skill.stoneaxe.use.1: Punish a rock-weak target and catch low fliers too
worldcombat.skill.stoneaxe.use.2: Use Shatter to drop one heavy blow in a chokepoint
worldcombat.skill.stoneaxe.description.0: One close axe swing deals about %1$s Rock physical damage at about %2$s blocks, with a critical chance of about %3$s (higher than ordinary moves). The target's Defence and type matchup settle at impact.
worldcombat.skill.stoneaxe.description.1: On a hit (or when the landing point is not walled off) a limited field of floating rocks rises at the landing point, about %2$s blocks wide and lasting about %3$s. A non-friendly body with a clear line to the field's centre takes about %1$s Rock physical damage the moment it first enters (no need to be grounded), and one rock falls from directly above it. One rock strikes one newly-entering enemy only; staying inside is never struck again. If a block such as a roof blocks the vertical fall, the rock breaks on the roof, dealing no damage and consuming no rock. The same target must leave and re-enter, waiting %4$s before another rock falls.
worldcombat.skill.stoneaxe.shatter.on: Shatter: the whole stock drops at once on the first intruder for a single strike, then the field is spent; x1.8 per strike (never multiplied by the rock count), but duration x0.7, radius x0.9 and axe power x0.92 - one heavy blow.
worldcombat.skill.stoneaxe.shatter.off: Hover (default): one rock per newly-entering enemy, spent once thrown, wider and axe power x1.05, but each strike is x0.85.
worldcombat.skill.stoneaxe.timing: Range %1$s, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.stoneaxe.growth.0: From level %1$s the axe power rises to %2$s and the rock strike to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.stoneaxe.growth.1: From level %1$s the axe power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.stoneaxe.preference.sh: On: the whole stock drops at once on the first intruder for x1.8 per strike (never multiplied by the rock count), but duration x0.7, radius x0.9 and axe power x0.92 - one heavy blow. Off: hover form, one rock per newly-entering enemy, spent once thrown, wider and axe power x1.05, but each strike is x0.85.
worldcombat.skill.stoneaxe.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the companion closes in instead of swinging; larger values let it commit from further away.

When on, a target with neighbours gets priority, so the rock field left where enemies must pass can drop one rock each on several comers (including low fliers); when off, it ranks as an ordinary melee attack.
